escenas.descripcion: Jesus sits on the Mount of Olives outdoors, speaking with serene gravity to his attentive disciples about the coming events in Jerusalem.
Dramatic luminous phenomena in the sky around the sun and moon above a turbulent sea, while a crowd gazes upward in awe.
The Son of Man descending upon soft glowing clouds in heavenly majesty, extending a welcoming hand of hope towards the viewer.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand. Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein. For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled. Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people. They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled. There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves; men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken. Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory. But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.

“But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand. Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein. For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled. Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people. They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves; men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory. But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
Even if you see difficulties around you, do not lose hope or give in to fear. Christ comes to save you; do you trust in his love and presence today?

frase_es: abrid los ojos y alzad la cabeza, porque vuestra redención se acerca.
reflexion_es: Aunque veas dificultades a tu alrededor, no pierdas la esperanza ni te dejes llevar por el miedo. Cristo viene a salvarte, ¿confías hoy en su amor y en su presencia?
